name: Sokubaku
source:
Main heroine is longing for her elite boss sent over from the head office. She gladly accepts her boss' invitation for a meal. The darkness in her heart is growing...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角暗恋着从总公司派来的精英上司，并欣然接受了上司共进晚餐的邀请。她心底的黑暗正在不断滋长……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
